info.title: Folio Core
info.description: Local-first voice labeling & knowledge organization — core service.

Choose the project's LLM. A hosted (non-loopback) endpoint is an explicit cloud opt-in.

post.description:
The UI reports its selection, so a desktop hotkey (which knows nothing about the UI)
labels the right thing.

One endpoint for a global hotkey (e.g. a Hyprland bind calling `folio-core voice toggle`).
The target defaults to whatever the UI has selected (sent as a 'focus' event).
Keyboard path into the same pipeline as voice: transcript -> preview.

post.description: Correct a misheard transcript in the preview; the label is re-planned.

get.description:
Server-sent events: ledger changes, job progress, source status, voice state.
The UI invalidates its caches on each message, so every view updates together (FR-6).

put.description: User-editable schema (FR-4). Every save is a new version; claims record their version.

Extractor.title: Extractor
Extractor.description: Who or what made a claim (FR-10 provenance).

Locator.title: Locator
Locator.description:
Where inside a source a piece of evidence lives.

kind="page": PDF page (1-based) and optional rect [x0, y0, x1, y1] in PDF points.
kind="region": image region in pixels.
kind="time": media start/end in seconds.
kind="text": line range in a text-like file (1-based, inclusive).
kind="label": the evidence is a voice/typed label.
